subject: Re: Acme - Pricing & Invoice Estimate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Acme — Post-call recap & pricing worksheet

Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap + next steps from our discovery call so we have shared assumptions before I send a formal invoice estimate.

Call notes / assumptions:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + dynamic suggestions (chat + generate).
- Expected active volume: 200k MAU (Acme estimate) with ~20% using the feature daily.
- Average session: 600 tokens in / 500 tokens out -> ~1,100 total tokens per session.
- Peak concurrency: ~50 QPS, sustained ~10 QPS.
- SLA: 99.9% latency target for interactive flows, acceptable to use dedicated pool for peak hours.

Target budget: you mentioned a budget range of $40k-60k/month. You also asked for target unit economics expressed as $/1M tokens; you suggested a target of ~$120 per 1M tokens to hit target margin internally.

Preliminary Redwood estimate (high-level):
- Per 1M tokens (hosted): $95 baseline for the model profile we discussed (Redwood-curated LlamaX-13B quantized runtime).
- With a 12-month committed capacity (Reserved / Dedicated): we can get to $70-80 per 1M tokens depending on committed volume and burst rules.
- Example ballpark invoice: assuming 200k MAU * 20% daily * 30 days * 1,100 tokens/session = ~1.32B tokens/month -> at $95/1M = $125,400/month; at $75/1M = $99,000/month.

Attachments: I've attached the initial pricing calculator and a short unit-economics export so you can tweak volumes on your side.
[Attachment: acme-pricing-calculator.xlsx]
[Attachment: redwood-unit-economics.pdf]
[Attachment: 20261110-acme-estimate.csv]

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the MAU and average tokens/session (or share telemetry) so I can update the calculator?
2) Is a 12-month committed/discounted proposal something you can take to procurement? If not, what budget range should I use for a flex/hosted quote?
3) If procurement needs a PO/SOW, loop Priya in (cc'd) and I'll prepare a one-page SOW + invoice estimate.

I'll follow up with a formal invoice estimate once you confirm the numbers.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher

From: Alex Taylor <alex.taylor@acmecorp.com>

Thanks Sean — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:
- MAU: the 200k number was our high-level product funnel; active users for this feature will likely be ~100k MAU in Q1, scaling to 250k MAU by Q3.
- Average tokens: our telemetry team reports ~550 input tokens / ~450 output tokens (we used conservative 1,000 tokens/session in planning); 1,000 tokens/session is fine for a baseline.
- Budget: procurement gave a soft cap of $60k/month for year-one pilots but we can escalate to $100k/month with exec approval if the value is proven.
- Procurement: Priya is our procurement lead — she'll want an invoice-level estimate and an outline of committed discounts and cancellation terms.

Can you do two invoice scenarios for us:
A) Pilot — 3 month flex/hosted at observed 100k MAU (1,000 tokens/session).
B) Committed — 12 month dedicated/reserved for 250k MAU (1,000 tokens/session) with suggested discount tiers.

If you can send those as separate tabs in the spreadsheet (pilot vs committed) and highlight the $/1M tokens and total monthly invoice, that would be ideal.

Thanks — looped Priya for procurement.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:00:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Acme — pricing scenarios (internal)

Sean / Dev — I ran the numbers on Alex's ask and attached a short CSV with scenario outputs. Key points / recommended approach:
- Pilot (3m flex): price as hosted; we should use $95/1M tokens as baseline, but include a cap on overage pricing and an option to convert to committed credits mid-term.
- Committed (12m): recommend offering a 20% discount at a 12-month minimum commit that hits >= 2.5B tokens/month sustained, which would take unit to $76/1M. If they commit to 5B tokens/month, we can go to $65/1M.
- Model selection: suggest LlamaX-13B quantized for pilot; propose LlamaX-30B (higher cost) only if quality tests demand it — use evals to gate.
- Margin: with $76/1M we keep ~25% gross margin after infra costs and reserved amortization; can push to ~30% at larger commit.

I've created two tabs: pilot_estimate and committed_tiers (CSV exported). Please review and I'll produce an invoice-level PDF once Sean confirms the final inputs.

[Attachment: 20261112-acme-scenarios.csv]

Marissa Cole

Alex / Priya — thanks for the clarifications. Attached is the invoice-level estimate with two tabs (Pilot / Committed) and a one-page summary of unit economics. Summary below:

Pilot scenario (3m flex):
- Assumptions: 100k MAU active, 1,000 tokens/session, 20% daily usage -> ~600M tokens/month.
- Unit price: $95 / 1M tokens (hosted flex)
- Estimated invoice: $57,000 / month (excl. taxes)

Committed scenario (12m reserved):
- Assumptions: 250k MAU, 1,000 tokens/session -> ~1.5B tokens/month.
- Suggested discount tiers: 20% off at >=2.5B tokens/month (effective $76/1M); 30% off at >=5B tokens/month (effective $66.5/1M).
- Example price @1.5B (no higher-tier): if they commit to 1.5B, we'd propose a 12-month reserved plan at $80/1M (midpoint discount) -> $120,000 / month. If they move to 2.5B commit, the invoice would be ~$190,000 / month at $76/1M.

Next steps:
1) Priya — can you confirm whether procurement needs a PO or if a DocuSign SOW is sufficient for moving forward?
2) Alex — if the pilot looks good, we can issue a 3-month hosted invoice and schedule a technical kickoff.
3) I'll create a DocuSign SOW for the pilot + an optional conversion path to reserved credits. I've created a HubSpot deal and attached the estimator. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ACME-2457

Attachments: invoice-estimate-acme-20261115.xlsx (tabs: pilot_estimate, committed_tiers), redwood-unit-economics.pdf
